evals.name: open-in-preview
evals.expected_output: Trunk serves the browser build on port 8765, a preview tab shows it, and the agent has looked at a snapshot image of the app.
assertions: The agent starts `trunk serve --config crates/pensive/Trunk.toml` in the background, or reuses a server already answering on port 8765
The agent waits for the server to answer before opening the preview
The agent checks the page with a snapshot image, not only the accessibility tree
The server and the tab are still running at the end

evals.name: trunk-missing
evals.prompt: Show me Pensive in a browser tab.
evals.expected_output: With no `trunk` on the PATH, the agent asks the user to install it and installs nothing itself.
assertions: The final message asks the user to run `cargo install trunk --locked`
The agent ran no install command
